messages.title: For you first
messages.body: You know more of this than you think. Take it slowly, and lean on Pat and Casey.

responsibilities.name: Paying the monthly bills
responsibilities.howItWorks:
Most bills autopay from the joint checking account at Sample Credit Union.
The water bill is paid by hand on the city website around the 10th.
I check the account every Sunday morning for anything unusual.
responsibilities.recordsLocation: Paper statements: blue folder in the office file drawer.
responsibilities.whoCanHelp: Sample Credit Union branch staff can explain the autopays.
responsibilities.notes: Consider moving the water bill to autopay so there is nothing to remember.

responsibilities.name: Preparing and filing taxes
responsibilities.howItWorks:
Casey Rivera at Example Tax Partners prepares our return each March.
I collect the year-end forms in the "Taxes this year" envelope and drop them off by March 1.
responsibilities.recordsLocation: Past returns: fire safe, bottom shelf. Seven years kept.

responsibilities.name: Home Wi-Fi and devices
responsibilities.howItWorks:
The router is in the hall closet. Unplugging it for 30 seconds fixes most problems.
The internet provider is Example Fiber.
responsibilities.recordsLocation: Router admin details are in the family password manager under "Router".

responsibilities.name: Furnace filter and fall maintenance
responsibilities.howItWorks: Filter size 16x25x1, changed every three months. Example HVAC Services does a check every October.

responsibilities.name: Feeding and walking Biscuit
responsibilities.howItWorks: Two meals a day, one cup each. Walks morning and evening. Vet is Sample Animal Clinic.

people.name: Alex Morgan
people.notes: Wrote this plan and handles most paperwork.

people.name: Riley Morgan
people.needs: Riley does best with a clear daily schedule. School pickup is at 3:15.

contacts.name: Pat Lee
contacts.instructions: Call first for anything at the house. Pat can let helpers in.

contacts.name: Casey Rivera, Example Tax Partners
contacts.instructions: Call within the first few weeks. Casey knows our finances well and can explain what needs attention.

contacts.name: Sample Insurance Company
contacts.instructions: Call for any claim. Policy details are in the fire safe.

contacts.name: Example HVAC Services
contacts.instructions: Annual furnace check in October. Call if the heat stops.

health.name: Dr. Sam Example, Example Family Clinic

home.name: Water main shutoff
home.instructions: Turn clockwise a quarter turn to close.

home.name: Home internet
home.instructions: Router is in the hall closet.

accounts.name: Sample Credit Union
accounts.access: Family password manager, emergency access granted to Jordan.
accounts.notes: Most bills autopay from this account.

accounts.name: Family password manager
accounts.access: Jordan has emergency access. Recovery kit is in the fire safe.
accounts.notes: This is where every other login lives.

documents.name: Will and estate documents
documents.location: Original with Example Law Office. Copy in fire safe.

plans.name: If Alex is suddenly unavailable
plans.trigger: Alex is in the hospital or cannot be reached for more than a day
plans.steps:
Call Pat Lee to help with Riley and Biscuit
Check the "First 24 hours" checklist
Call Casey Rivera only after the first week
Nothing financial is urgent in the first week

notes.name: Trash and recycling
notes.details:
Trash goes out Tuesday night.
Recycling every other Tuesday (green bin).

checklist.title: Choose two trusted backup contacts
checklist.note: Confirm how they should be reached.

checklist.title: Record utility shutoff locations
checklist.note: Include any tool needed to operate them.

checklist.title: Walk one trusted person through the plan
checklist.note: Show them where the current backup is stored.

checklist.title: Export an updated backup
checklist.note: Keep an offline copy somewhere protected.
